GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGene.objects: The original complete joint spectral Gaussian window, its calculated positive source-unit equilibrium, and the actual quadratic score on each precision law.
GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGene.comparison: The complete force is twice the weighted loss of the actual Gaussian score mean. Its derivative is twice the weighted conditional variance. The centred potential has zero force at the same equilibrium and its second derivative along every real ray is the calculated equilibrium curvature times the ray square.
GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGene.hypotheses_and_scope: The exact precision comparison is used on amplitudes z > -1/2; positive curvature is proved for B > 0 and z >= 0. The selected integer window is five under the existing least-admissible source-unit comparison protocol. All original labels and multiplicities remain. Conditional variance is not the variance of an uncentered spectral mixture. The physical score normalization and its numerical mass are not assigned to the arithmetic carrier; no full nonlinear path-integral identification or amplitude-uniform positive gap is claimed.

GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceComp.objects: The complete traceless endomorphism space on the actual arithmetic carrier with its computed coordinate Gram form.
GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceComp.comparison: The skew-adjoint real form has an explicit coordinate equivalence and unique reconstruction. The bilinear trace pairing is the computed Gram form, and not an assumed Euclidean coordinate metric.
GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceComp.hypotheses_and_scope: Arithmetic coordinates use all retained history coefficients and eliminate one trace entry. Their real form satisfies adjointCoordinates(c) = -c; it is not the entrywise-real condition of an orthonormal Hermitian Gell-Mann basis. The trace metric includes its derived cross term.

GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGene.objects: Local jets of the generated faithful source-frame action on the complete arithmetic state carrier, together with the original connection and coupled state functional.
GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGene.comparison: The inverse product rule gives covariant frame derivatives. Their complete trace norm is exactly twice the sum of the existing covariant kinetic energies over all orthonormal state columns. The same columns determine the full frame action, its positivity, gauge invariance, constant-source restriction and uniqueness on the source orbit.
GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGene.hypotheses_and_scope: This is the local arithmetic jet construction. It retains every arithmetic/source matrix coefficient. The coefficient is the actual defining Casimir and the trace is unnormalized; no physical colour multiplicity or radial-response coefficient is copied. The existing continuous Haar operator and arbitrary global differentiable frame realization are separate constructions.
